name: bld3_pell_five_one_solutions
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld2_pell_five_solutions_lucas: (2x)^2 = 5 (2y)^2 + 4, so 2y = fib (2m) and 2x = p3_lucas (2m); fib (2m) is even iff 3 ∣ 2m iff 3 ∣ m (fib mod 2 has period 3), so 2m = 6n.
type: ∀ (x y : ℕ), x ^ 2 = 5 * y ^ 2 + 1 → ∃ n, 2 * y = Nat.fib (6 * n) ∧ 2 * x = Mathlib2.p3_lucas (6 * n)
